samples.text: The coordinator reads the backlog once, assigns each file to exactly one owner and writes the interface contract before any worker starts. Workers run in separate worktrees, so two agents never edit the same path. When a request would carry more input than the ceiling allows, the agent stops, writes a short handoff note and a fresh agent continues from that note instead of from the whole conversation. Nothing in this process depends on the network: the estimate is a pure function of the text, which keeps the decision reproducible across machines and across runs. If the provider reports real usage, that number replaces the estimate, and the record says which of the two it is. A conservative estimator may overcount, but it must never undercount, because an undercount is the only way to cross the ceiling without noticing. Reviewers check the diff against the acceptance criteria, run the targeted tests, and approve or reject with evidence rather than opinion.
